entries.name: Reptilian, Reptilians
entries.content:
Reptilian are a race of reptilian humanoids that are divided into three castes, namely "Crocodilian", "Lizardfolk" and "Serpentfolk".
All three castes emerged on the African continent and have a very low population, representing only 0.000625% of the world's population, with Crocodilians (35% of the species), Lizardfolk (50% of the species) and Serpentfolks (15% of the species ).
Reptilians do not have a female gender, they are all male and heteronormative individuals, they reproduce by laying eggs when they decide they are ready to procreate, thus causing self-fertilization without mating. Each Reptilian can lay about 1 to 2 eggs at a time.

entries.name: Crocodilian, Crocodilians
entries.content:
Crocodilians can refer to both crocodilian animals and the caste of the Reptilian race called Crocodilian.
Crocodilians are peaceful in nature, most of them live in the center and east of the African continent spread across the Republic of Congo, Burundi, Tanzania and Kenya.
Crocodilian are the strongest physically among the three castes of Reptilians, having very hypertrophied bodies, they are also the best swimmers of the three castes, being able to have superhuman speeds in the water.
Their bodies are covered in crocodile scales ranging in color from green, brown and gray. Its teeth are large and sharp within a powerful jaw on a long, long snout. They have tails measuring around 1.15m long, can reach up to 2.10m tall and weigh an average of 185kg. Its hands and feet end in small black claws on the fingers. Its body temperature is 41° Celcius. Their diet is exclusively fish and vegetables, but many are already vegan.

entries.name: Lizardfolk, Lizardfolks
entries.content:
Lizardfolks are a caste of the Reptilian race.
They are shy and introverted in nature, most of them live in central Africa, on the edge of river regions in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Congo and the Central African Republic.
Lizardfolk are physically strong but not muscular, they are individuals who live further away from human regions due to their timid nature.
Their bodies are covered in dark green, light green, and brown reptilian scales. Its teeth are small and sharp inside a long lizard-like snout. They have tails measuring around 1.35m long, can reach up to 1.90m tall and weigh an average of 130kg. Its hands and feet end in black claws on the fingers. Its body temperature is 40° Celcius. Its diet is exclusively roots, fruits and eggs.

entries.name: Serpentfolk, Serpentfolks
entries.content:
Serpentfolks are a caste of the Reptilian race.
They are normally aggressive and introverted in nature. They live in small villages in the center and south of the African continent, spread across small communities in the south of the Democratic Republic of Congo, Zambia, Zimbabwe and Botswana.
Serpentfolk are physically slender and do not have legs and move with their serpentine body dragging along the ground, this does not mean that they are slow, as they can run at considerable speeds, these individuals are known for getting into conflicts with poachers as they are defenders of the balance of fauna in their regions.
Their bodies are covered in reptilian scales that range from black and red to brown and beige, some may have a fan like cobras and others may not. Their teeth are like venom-injecting snakes and yes, they have deadly poisons in their bites, they can reach up to 2.00 meters in height and weigh an average of 100kg. Its hands end in black or purple claws on the fingers. Their body temperature is 39° Celcius. Their diet is exclusively small rodents, eggs and fruit, although some already adopt a vegan diet.
